answer: A beacon-audit pulse bond stops mass fakes. Each newcomer locks 70, files a key on the mesa registry, with a sponsor. Each epoch the beacon picks random identities; each picked one answers in 10 min with a fresh key-signed pulse. A late, missed, or rented pulse burns the bond; a ripple audit follows its sponsor. First 42, k-th 42+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,039,000 + 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once, keeping the bond.
